files.content:
# Returns Rush Game Brief

Theme: a busy returns desk sorting accepted parcels from exception parcels.

Required mechanics:
- Move a sorting cart left and right with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (A/D may also work).
- Accepted parcels add one point.
- Exception parcels remove one life.
- Start with three lives.
- Win at 10 points and lose at zero lives.
- Show score, lives, controls, and current state on screen.
- After win or game over, an in-page control restarts a fresh round.
- Keep the game self-contained in one index.html with no network assets.
